purpose: chlrm with every new flag off: release code (branch encoder-pilots-20261025) vs the chlrm pilot commit e58f1c0, fixed real hammer batch (16 training windows), seed 0, real CUDA renderer, bf16; local MIG-c3511b41 (idle slice)
